title: Navimower 0.4.5-beta26

## Prepared History backend

This prerelease prepares the integration side of the next Map Card History
migration while remaining compatible with Map Card 0.3.7-beta14.

Completed retained sessions now become immutable, content-addressed History
resources instead of depending only on the older session-id render endpoint.

### Retained-session prewarm

At startup the Session Archive manager now prewarms every retained completed
session with at least two route points, one session at a time.

- Existing persisted session-render archives are reused.
- Missing or outdated archives are rebuilt in Home Assistant's executor.
- Active sessions are excluded and remain on the live Prepared SVG + short-tail
  path.
- A newly completed session is still protected by the existing settle/reopen
  guard before publication.
- The exact timestamped History session Store remains the source of truth.

This means the next Map Card beta can open History from already prepared
resources instead of triggering on-demand render work.

## Ready-only History manifest

New authenticated endpoint:

`/api/navimower/history-manifest/{entry_id}`

The manifest contains retained session metadata plus, for each completed session,
a ready descriptor when its render resource is prepared.

It reports:

- retained session count;
- eligible completed session count;
- ready session count;
- pending session count;
- prewarm started/completed state;
- publication revision;
- content-addressed resource descriptors.

Active sessions remain in the metadata list but never receive a completed
History render descriptor.

Prepared History discovery is also advertised through:

- the existing Sessions endpoint;
- Map/Site frontend metadata;
- Prepared Render Model discovery and manifest.

This prepares both Single and Multi mower consumers without requiring entity
registry scans in the browser.

## Immutable content-addressed History resources

New authenticated endpoint:

`/api/navimower/history-resource/{entry_id}/{resource_id}`

Each resource contains the existing SVG-ready completed-session render artifact:

- mowed-area path;
- travel/return path;
- complete route fallback;
- source fingerprint and render schema metadata.

Resource identity is SHA-256 based and excludes the operational
`generated_at` timestamp, so regenerating the same completed session produces
the same resource id.

History resources use:

- `Cache-Control: private, max-age=31536000, immutable`;
- ETag;
- `If-None-Match`;
- HTTP 304 responses.

The existing
`/api/navimower/session-render/{entry_id}/{session_id}`
endpoint remains available as the beta14/legacy fallback. Beta26 does not
require a Map Card change.

## Retention cleanup

Prepared session-render Stores now maintain a small derived archive index.

When a source History session is removed by the configured retention policy,
its indexed derived render Store is removed as well. This prevents prepared
History archives from accumulating after their source sessions have expired.

Config-entry removal now cleans both the current History index and the prepared
render archive index.

## Diagnostics

Home Assistant diagnostics now exposes the same cached-only block as both
`prepared_history` and the compatibility alias `session_render_archive`.

New fields include:

- `prewarm_started`;
- `prewarm_complete`;
- `retained_session_count`;
- `eligible_session_count`;
- `ready_session_count`;
- `pending_session_count`;
- `prewarm_build_count`;
- `prewarm_cache_hit_count`;
- `lazy_build_count`;
- `legacy_render_reads`;
- `publication_revision`;
- manifest/resource read counts and first/last read ages;
- total ready resource bytes;
- actual resource bytes served;
- 304 count;
- indexed/pruned derived archive Store counts;
- archive-index failures;
- existing build/cache/failure/latency state.

The expected field-test result before the Map Card History migration is:

- `prewarm_complete: true`;
- `ready_session_count == eligible_session_count`;
- `pending_session_count: 0`;
- zero build/index failures.

## Cleanup

The unused old `history_day_count` map metadata field has been removed.

The legacy `daily_trails` API and old session-render endpoint are intentionally
retained in beta26 because Map Card beta14 and older compatibility paths still
exist. They should only be removed after the Prepared History frontend has been
field-tested.

## Compatibility and next step

Map Card 0.3.7-beta14 continues to work unchanged.

The intended validation sequence is:

1. finish the beta14 short-tail field test;
2. install NaviMower 0.4.5-beta26;
3. confirm all retained eligible sessions become ready in diagnostics;
4. build/install the next Map Card beta to consume the Prepared History
   manifest/resources;
5. only then remove redundant frontend History/raw/daily-trail compatibility
   paths.
